Cold Plunge Before or After a Workout?

If you lift to build muscle, avoid cold plunging right after strength training: studies found it reduced gains in muscle size, and a 2021 meta-analysis found regular use hurt strength training results. If you need to recover fast for the next session or game, or you mostly do endurance work, a plunge after training helps soreness and does not appear to hurt aerobic fitness. On lifting days, plunge before training or several hours later.
